Plans.Filter: ((entity_type = 'drug_product'::text) AND ((fields ->> 'drug_name'::text) ~~* '%metformin%'::text) AND ((NULLIF(btrim((fields ->> 'ingredient_strength_description'::text)), ''::text) IS NULL) OR ((fields ->> 'ingredient_strength_description'::text) ~~* '%500 MG%'::text)) AND ((NULLIF(btrim((fields ->> 'dose_form'::text)), ''::text) IS NULL) OR ((fields ->> 'dose_form'::text) ~~* '%TABLET%'::text)))

query_plan.interpretation: Existing indexes bound the read to the exact selected 4,547-row source derivation; literal predicates filter that slice. No dedicated drug-name/strength/form index or global name scan was added.
query_plan.sql:
WITH matched AS MATERIALIZED (
 SELECT * FROM dl_evidence.observation WHERE derivation_id=%s
 AND entity_type='drug_product' AND source_table='drug_identities'
 AND source_row_ordinal>%s AND fields->>'drug_name' ILIKE %s ESCAPE '!'
 AND (%s::text IS NULL OR NULLIF(btrim(fields->>'ingredient_strength_description'),'') IS NULL
      OR fields->>'ingredient_strength_description' ILIKE %s ESCAPE '!')
 AND (%s::text IS NULL OR NULLIF(btrim(fields->>'dose_form'),'') IS NULL
      OR fields->>'dose_form' ILIKE %s ESCAPE '!')
 ORDER BY source_row_ordinal LIMIT %s)
 SELECT o.*,r.raw_payload,r.raw_sha256,r.record_id,r.source_row_key,r.ordinal_basis,
 d.snapshot_id,d.adapter_code_sha256,s.original_path,s.artifact_sha256,
 s.source_use_state AS snapshot_source_use_state,
 o.fields->>'drug_name' ILIKE %s ESCAPE '!' AS name_literal_observed,
 CASE WHEN NULLIF(btrim(o.fields->>'ingredient_strength_description'),'') IS NULL THEN NULL
      ELSE o.fields->>'ingredient_strength_description' ILIKE %s ESCAPE '!' END AS strength_literal_observed,
 CASE WHEN NULLIF(btrim(o.fields->>'dose_form'),'') IS NULL THEN NULL
      ELSE o.fields->>'dose_form' ILIKE %s ESCAPE '!' END AS form_literal_observed
 FROM matched o JOIN dl_evidence.source_record r USING(derivation_id,source_table,source_row_ordinal)
 JOIN dl_control.derivation d USING(derivation_id)
 JOIN dl_control.source_snapshot s USING(snapshot_id) ORDER BY o.source_row_ordinal

remaining_limits: Operator-only discovery over the retained 4,547-row dictionary, not a complete or current terminology service.
Case-insensitive literal substrings retrieve candidates; one result or a strength-text occurrence is not identity or dose equivalence.
Only outer query whitespace is removed; no typo correction, synonym/brand expansion, ingredient inference or unit conversion.
Source strength/form omissions remain unknown even when the name contains apparent details; packs are not decomposed.
Optional strength/form filters retain name candidates whose corresponding source attribute is missing, explicitly unresolved.
A missing literal result is unknown within this selection; it is not absence of coverage, a clinical finding or a suggested substitute.
Exact RxCUI selection and item/report-specific confirmation are separate actions; no customer item is bound here.
The dictionary has no offering/formulary membership, quantity, pharmacy, price or personal approval grain.
Source access, evidence/method acceptance and consumer-purpose release remain held independently of discovery.
Eight selected query pages and their returned raw parents were checked, not whole-dictionary semantic correctness or current RxNorm status.
Wildcard, continuation, source omission, pack and unknown-result cases are public source/fixture queries, not customer profile matches.
Literal strength text can occur within a different numeric expression, such as 5 MG inside 2.5 MG; this seam never treats the occurrence as dose equivalence.
No source acquisition, fuzzy resolver, synonym service, dose conversion, plan/formulary check, pharmacy/price check, HTTP/UI or actual profile integration is supplied.
The separate exact-RxCUI lookup and owner/item/report-specific confirmation composition require their own integration checks; discovery grants neither identity binding nor output authority.

L05_allowed_outputs: Internal exact-drug/plan research lookup and inspectable condition evidence with explicit dates, flags and unknown states.
Drug name/strength/form identity confirmation candidates from the retained CMS/NLM dictionary, subject to trusted matching/explicit confirmation rather than fuzzy auto-binding.
Review catalog of resolved and unresolved source rows without personal approval claims.
L05_held_outputs: Consumer accepted drug-coverage release (actual human acceptance remains null).
Automatic PA/ST clinical adjudication, personal clinical approval, normalized days supply from unsupported units or a coverage/price promise.
Backdating October criteria into September or converting current questionnaire presence into full criteria completeness.
Drug-based recommendation/annual cost ranking before L06/L07 and exact personal facts/models/acceptance.
source_policy_binding.meaning: Existing internal research permission; no new source permission, acceptance or consumer release.
